-- Decompiled from run-only bytecode: comments and original formatting are not recoverable.

property counter : 0
on add(a, b)
	return a + b
end add

on greet given name:n
	return "hi " & n
end greet

set g to 1
set counter to counter + (my add(1, 2))
set s to greet given name:"bob"
considering case
	set c to "a" = "A"
end considering
ignoring white space
	set c to "a b" = "ab"
end ignoring
set y to a reference to counter
set x to contents of y
set d to date "Monday, January 1, 2024 at 12:00:00 AM"
set m to month of d
tell me
	add(1, 1)
end tell
